seo_title: Corporate & Group Food Tours KL & Penang | Simply Enak
seo_description: Hosting colleagues in KL or Penang? We take work groups to the stalls locals eat at.
hero_subtitle: Hosting colleagues in KL or Penang? We take work groups and corporate visitors to the stalls locals eat at.
offer_body_1: We don't do scripted team building. Instead, we take you somewhere real: a morning at the hawker stalls that bring people together through food they didn't expect to love.

offer_perfect_for.item: Work colleagues visiting KL or Penang at the same time
Corporate groups who want to eat where locals eat, not where tourists are sent
Teams wanting an active, engaging activity
International visitors wanting to understand Malaysian culture
Remote teams meeting up for retreats

offer_body_2: Our food tours are naturally team-building. You'll walk together, taste together, laugh together. No forced activities, no awkward icebreakers — just good food and the kind of conversations that happen when everyone's eating from the same plate.
